$comment: Per-file budgets for unbundled public assets. Baseline 2026-09-30 (raw/gzip bytes): events-calendar 8108/2793, going-count 2776/1145, member-profile 5193/1977, past-events 3778/1434, styles 2087/882. Ceilings leave roughly 25-45% headroom, not room for a framework import. The rebased copy-link island is initially budgeted at raw/gzip 2441/1009 bytes (ceilings 3072/1280). Stylesheet declarations and server-rendered class tokens are factored and minified; browser computed-style/bounds equivalence is checked against the pre-factor stylesheet. The newly merged avatar island (610 raw bytes) starts at 1024/512 raw/gzip ceilings. The admin-event-editor island has an initial 2026-10-01 baseline of 979/482 raw/gzip bytes and ceilings of 1280/640 (31-33% headroom); all pre-existing ceilings remain unchanged. The stylesheet ceilings remain 3072/1280 raw/gzip; growth on main must be optimized without removing styles or raising these ceilings here. Every JavaScript file under public/islands at any depth must have a budget. Raising a ceiling requires a separate deliberate PR explaining the growth; never relax a budget just to make CI green. The 2026-10-01 reconciliation adds two main-introduced islands with measured baselines and 25-30% headroom: admin-event-text-limits 1594/725 (ceilings 2048/1024) and auth-status 4152/1576 (ceilings 5120/2048). Main's 2026-10-01 theme architecture and feature merges pushed public/styles.css (3930/1527), going-count.js (5321/2062) and member-profile.js (12441/4024) past their legacy ceilings; those entries keep their legacy values here and the growth is handled by an owner-approved ceiling raise, so this checker intentionally reports them over budget until that decision lands. past-events.js fits after mechanical formatting compaction (4968/1696).
